dialogues.speaker: Lantern Riddle
dialogues.text: "Rock-hard flesh and bamboo bones. Lives in the city with thousands of clones."

dialogues.speaker: Lantern Riddle
dialogues.text: "Pitch-black sea marks the end of its flight. Within its body hides resplendent light."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Th—That's what a lantern riddle is? Too difficult for Paimon's little brain... Do you have any clue what the answer might be?

response.speaker: Qingzhou
response.text: Hmm... Wrong answer. You may wish to give it some more thought.

response.speaker: Qingzhou
response.text: Xiao Lanterns have bamboo frames and insides made of rocks. They float in the sky after release. You do not find them in the wild, and that's why each one "lives in the city."

response.speaker: Qingzhou
response.text: Even though the chunk of Plaustrite inside is not easily damaged, the lampshade can break. Once released, a Xiao Lantern may fall into the sea, which "marks the end of its flight."

response.speaker: Qingzhou
response.text: Even so, the wishes committed to the lanterns will not perish... Which is symbolized by their "resplendent light."

response.speaker: Little Liu
response.text: *sigh* I wouldn't have thought about it at all...

response.speaker: Little Liu
response.text: Wow, you're so smart! So... you should take this gift!

response.speaker: Little Liu
response.text: My friends say that you should always get some "loot" for guessing the right answer... This can be your "loot."
